description: Implement editor detail mode: 3-column layout with JSON preview right panel (B-2), SVG StateGraph component (B-3), and AppearancePanel with UV SVG (B-4). All gated on mode === 'advanced'. No external SVG library. Depends on FEAT-001 (EditorPage already has correct ARIA from that fix).
steps: Step 1 — Add new i18n keys to app/src/i18n/locales/ja.json (add inside 'editor' key): tabs.components='コンポーネント', tabs.stateGraph='状態グラフ'; jsonPreview={title:'JSON プレビュー', copyButton:'コピー'}; validation={title:'バリデーション結果', ok:'✓ OK', okMessage:'エラーなし。エクスポートできます。'}; preview3d={title:'3D プレビュー', placeholder:'（後で実装）', cameraReset:'⟳ 回転リセット', front:'前面', side:'側面', top:'上面'}; stateGraph={stateListTitle:'状態一覧', addState:'＋ 状態を追加', canvasHint:'ノードをドラッグして配置できます（実装予定）', selectedState:'選択中の状態', stateName:'状態名', animation:'アニメーション', transitions:'遷移条件', addTransition:'＋ 遷移を追加', zoom:'ズーム', reset:'↺ リセット'}; appearance={tabs:{geometry:'ジオメトリ', texture:'テクスチャ', material:'マテリアル'}, geometry:{fileLabel:'ファイルパス', idLabel:'ジオメトリ識別子', browseButton:'参照', bonesTitle:'ボーン一覧', attachmentTitle:'アタッチメントポイント'}, texture:{slotsTitle:'テクスチャスロット', uvTitle:'UV マッピング', addSlot:'＋ スロットを追加', change:'変更', mappingType:'マッピングタイプ', textureSize:'テクスチャサイズ'}, material:{simpleNotice:'マテリアル設定は詳細モードで確認できます。', title:'マテリアル設定', materialName:'マテリアル名', renderController:'レンダーコントローラー', shaderSettings:'シェーダー設定', culling:'カリングモード', blend:'ブレンドモード', emissive:'エミッシブ係数'}}; components={addButton:'＋ コンポーネントを追加', placeholder:'コンポーネントを選択してください'}. Run npm run build to confirm tsc accepts the new ja.json shape.

Step 2 — Add same keys with English values to app/src/i18n/locales/en.json (tabs.components='Components', tabs.stateGraph='State Graph', jsonPreview.title='JSON Preview', jsonPreview.copyButton='Copy', validation.title='Validation Results', validation.ok='✓ OK', validation.okMessage='No errors. Ready to export.', preview3d.title='3D Preview', preview3d.placeholder='(Coming later)', preview3d.cameraReset='⟳ Reset Rotation', preview3d.front='Front', preview3d.side='Side', preview3d.top='Top', stateGraph.stateListTitle='States', stateGraph.addState='+ Add State', stateGraph.canvasHint='Drag nodes to reposition (coming soon)', stateGraph.selectedState='Selected State', stateGraph.stateName='State Name', stateGraph.animation='Animation', stateGraph.transitions='Transitions', stateGraph.addTransition='+ Add Transition', stateGraph.zoom='Zoom', stateGraph.reset='↺ Reset', appearance.tabs.geometry='Geometry', appearance.tabs.texture='Texture', appearance.tabs.material='Material', appearance.geometry.fileLabel='File Path', appearance.geometry.idLabel='Geometry ID', appearance.geometry.browseButton='Browse', appearance.geometry.bonesTitle='Bone List', appearance.geometry.attachmentTitle='Attachment Points', appearance.texture.slotsTitle='Texture Slots', appearance.texture.uvTitle='UV Mapping', appearance.texture.addSlot='+ Add Slot', appearance.texture.change='Change', appearance.texture.mappingType='Mapping Type', appearance.texture.textureSize='Texture Size', appearance.material.simpleNotice='Material settings are available in Advanced Mode.', appearance.material.title='Material Settings', appearance.material.materialName='Material Name', appearance.material.renderController='Render Controller', appearance.material.shaderSettings='Shader Settings', appearance.material.culling='Culling Mode', appearance.material.blend='Blend Mode', appearance.material.emissive='Emissive Factor', components.addButton='+ Add Component', components.placeholder='Select a component').

Step 3 — Create app/src/components/editor/JsonPreviewPanel.tsx. Props interface: { entityName: string }. Renders 3 sections styled per wireframe #06 right panel: (1) JSON preview: dark bg (#1E1E1E), border-radius 6px, renders a JSON.stringify of a mock entity object using entityName in the identifier field, syntax-highlighted with colored <span> elements (json-key blue, json-str orange, json-num green, json-punct gray) — no external library; (2) Validation section: green '✓ OK' badge + success message; (3) 3D Preview placeholder: gray box with emoji and t('editor.preview3d.placeholder'). Section titles use t(). Camera buttons row using t('editor.preview3d.cameraReset') etc. Export: named 'export const JsonPreviewPanel'.

Step 4 — Create app/src/components/editor/ComponentPanel.tsx. No props. Internal state: expandedId (string | null) initialized to 'health'. Renders a vertical list of minecraft: component accordion items. Each item: header div with component name in monospace font + chevron toggle, onClick sets/clears expandedId. Expanded 'health' item shows two slider rows (体力(max) and 初期値) using the slider pattern from wireframe #06 (track div + fill div + thumb div, no external library). Collapsed items (attack, movement, behavior.melee_attack) show only their header. Bottom: dashed-border add button using t('editor.components.addButton'). Export: named 'export const ComponentPanel'.

Step 5 — Create app/src/components/editor/StateGraph.tsx. Types (define at top of file): interface StateNode { id: string; isInitial: boolean; animation: string; x: number; y: number; }; interface StateTransition { from: string; to: string; condition: string; }. Component exports: 'export const StateGraph'. Internal state: useState<StateNode[]> with 5 initial states matching wireframe #08 positions: idle {x:20, y:90, isInitial:true, animation:'animation.idle'}, walk {x:190, y:90, animation:'animation.walk'}, attack {x:360, y:88, animation:'animation.attack'}, hurt {x:190, y:230, animation:'animation.hurt'}, death {x:190, y:330, animation:'animation.death'}. useState<StateTransition[]> with transitions: idle→walk, walk→attack, walk→hurt, attack→hurt, hurt→death. useState<string|null>('attack') for selectedStateId. Layout: flex h-full. Left panel (width 200px, border-right): state list with colored dots (green for isInitial), state names in monospace, active row highlighted green, add/delete icon buttons, 'add state' button. SVG canvas (flex-1): viewBox='0 0 540 420', background color #F4F5F7 with radial-gradient dot pattern (use inline style backgroundImage), <defs><marker> for gray and green arrow heads. Draw transitions as <line> elements with markerEnd, with the arrow tip offset to the target node border (compute from center-to-center vector: source point = center + normalized_dir * sqrt((NODE_W/2)^2 + (NODE_H/2)^2) clamped to rect border, target offset same approach). Node constants: NODE_W=110, NODE_H=40. Each node: <g role='button' onClick={() => setSelectedStateId(id)}> containing <rect> (green stroke + fill when selected, gray otherwise) and <text>. Initial state has a triangle <polygon> marker to its left. Right panel (width 280px, border-left, overflow-y-auto): shows selected state details — state name input, animation input, t('editor.stateGraph.transitions') section listing transitions FROM the selected state. Use t() for all labels.

Step 6 — Create app/src/components/editor/AppearancePanel.tsx. Import useUiStore, useTranslation, useState, useEffect from react. Type: type AppearanceSubTab = 'geometry' | 'texture' | 'material'. Internal state: useState<AppearanceSubTab>('geometry'). useEffect watching [mode]: if mode === 'simple' && activeSubTab === 'material', setActiveSubTab('geometry'). Layout: flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden. Sub-tab bar (flex, border-bottom, px-4): 3 buttons with role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls. ジオメトリ and テクスチャ always shown; マテリアル tab button only shown when mode === 'advanced' (conditional render, not CSS hide). Tab panel div with role=tabpanel. GEOMETRY PANEL: file path input row (input + 参照 button) + geometry identifier input + bone tree accordion (body/head/arm_left/arm_right/legs/leg_left/leg_right, static sample, 🦴/📦 icons, indented) + attachment points list (rightHand/leftHand/mouth). TEXTURE PANEL: slot list section (default and damage slots, each with 56x56 checkerboard-pattern thumbnail div using CSS linear-gradient, slot name, path, change button) + add slot button + UV Mapping SVG section: <svg width='288' height='288' viewBox='0 0 288 288'> containing checkerboard pattern <defs><pattern> + grid lines + 4 colored bone UV rect+label groups (body=green, head=blue, arm_left=orange, arm_right=yellow) with coordinate axes labels — adapt wireframe #10 SVG to React JSX (camelCase attributes: fillOpacity, strokeWidth, textAnchor, dominantBaseline, fontFamily, fontSize, fontWeight) + UV controls bar (zoom in/out/reset buttons, zoom state tracked with useState<number>(1.0), apply to SVG width/height). Detail-only parts in texture panel: mapping type select and texture size inputs — render only when mode === 'advanced'. MATERIAL PANEL: when mode === 'simple', render a centered notice div with t('editor.appearance.material.simpleNotice') and a 'switch to advanced' hint; when mode === 'advanced', render material name select + render controller input + shader settings (culling select, blend select, emissive input). All labels use t(). Export: named 'export const AppearancePanel'.

Step 7 — Update app/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: (1) Add import for useUiStore at top. (2) Add imports for JsonPreviewPanel, ComponentPanel, StateGraph, AppearancePanel. (3) Read mode from useUiStore(): const { mode } = useUiStore(). (4) Extend EditorTab type to include 'components' and 'stateGraph'. (5) Change the TABS const to be computed based on mode: simple tabs are ['traits','status','appearance']; advanced tabs are ['traits','status','components','stateGraph','appearance'] (use useMemo or just inline conditional). The TABS array must include i18n key mappings for all 5 tabs. (6) Change outer layout div from 'flex flex-1 overflow-hidden min-h-0' to same but add conditional third column: {mode === 'advanced' && <aside className='w-[30%] min-w-[220px] max-w-[360px] bg-white border-l border-[#E5E7EB] flex flex-col overflow-y-auto flex-shrink-0'><JsonPreviewPanel entityName={entityName} /></aside>}. Left sidebar keeps w-60 min-w-[200px] max-w-xs. (7) Wire tab content: 'components' renders <ComponentPanel />, 'stateGraph' renders <StateGraph />, 'appearance' renders <AppearancePanel />. (8) IMPORTANT: activeTab must reset to 'traits' when switching from advanced to simple if the current activeTab is 'components' or 'stateGraph' — add useEffect watching [mode] for this. (9) The TABS type annotation for labelKey must cover all 5 possible keys; use a union type or change to string with a type assertion.

Step 8 — Run npm run build from app/ and fix any TypeScript errors. Common issues: unused imports (noUnusedLocals), wrong camelCase for SVG attributes (use React SVG attribute names), missing i18n key types if ja.json structure is wrong, exactOptionalPropertyTypes violations. Then run npm test from app/. All 19 tests from FEAT-001 must still pass. Commit: feat(editor): add detail mode layout, StateGraph, AppearancePanel, JsonPreviewPanel (B-2 B-3 B-4)
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with 0 TypeScript errors
npm test exits 0 with 19 tests passing
In advanced mode (mode==='advanced'), EditorPage renders 3 columns: left sidebar + center + right panel containing JsonPreviewPanel
In simple mode, the right panel is absent (2-column layout)
In advanced mode, the tab bar includes コンポーネント and 状態グラフ tabs not present in simple mode
The 状態グラフ tab renders a pure-SVG state machine with at least 5 nodes (idle/walk/attack/hurt/death) and connecting arrows
The 外観 tab renders AppearancePanel with 3 sub-tabs; マテリアル tab is only accessible in advanced mode
AppearancePanel texture tab shows an SVG UV mapping diagram with colored bone regions
Switching from advanced to simple while on コンポーネント or 状態グラフ tab auto-resets activeTab to traits
Switching AppearancePanel to simple while on マテリアル sub-tab auto-resets to ジオメトリ
findings: Implemented successfully. Build: 0 TS errors (tsc -b + vite build). Tests: 19/19 pass. One type fix required: EditorPage TabDef.labelKey needed an explicit union type (EditorTabLabelKey) instead of string — i18next's strict overloads reject string even with a type assertion. All 5 new components created (JsonPreviewPanel, ComponentPanel, StateGraph, AppearancePanel, updated EditorPage). i18n keys added to ja.json (type source), en.json, and ja-kids.json (kids-specific text only).
